The manager gives back $5. Each takes $1, leaving $2. $27 + $2 = $29. Where's the missing dollar?", color: "teal", icon: Brain }, { title: "Bridge Crossing", difficulty: "Medium", description: "Four people must cross a bridge at night with one torch. What's the probability?", color: "coral", icon: Lightbulb }, { title: "Prisoners and Hats", difficulty: "Hard", description: "100 prisoners in line, each with a random black/white hat.
